subject: CFRN
title: French Language and Culture - Beginner
description: Speaking, writing, listening, and reading for students with no knowledge of French. Essential linguistic, communicative, and socio-cultural skills required to satisfy basic needs in familiar and predictable everyday situations. Strategies for independent learning and cultural discovery.

prerequisites.text: Entrance Placement Test or Permission of the Director

notes: This course is subject to limited enrolment.
